instruction: Convert all .docx files in the Desktop folder to ODT format via LibreOffice command-line tools using the terminal.

command: cd /home/user/Desktop && tar -zcf odt.tar.gz *.odt 2>/dev/null || echo 'no odt files'
output=$(cat ~/.bash_history | grep -E "(soffice|libreoffice).+--convert-to\s+odt.+\*\.docx"); if [ -z "$output" ]; then echo "failed to complete this task"; else echo "catch the desired command"; fi
